note: Document- and lineage-level identity for the Google DeepMind safety corpus. Lineages group documents that draw on the same underlying generative event. Derived from the FLI AI Safety Index Summer 2026 disclosure and publicly available materials. See SUBQUESTION.md for the curation defect and the closed-form lineage analysis.

google-deepmind-frontier-safety-framewor.label: Google DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework v3 (January 2026)
google-deepmind-frontier-safety-framewor.description: The framework document that defines Google DeepMind's safety thresholds, capability levels, and the SL-5 trigger. All later Google DeepMind safety documents derive from this lineage: the Gemini 2.5 model cards, the DeepMind blog posts, and the FLI Index column.

google-deepmind-gemini-2-5-lineage.label: Google DeepMind Gemini 2.5 model cards (Dec 2025 + May 2026)
google-deepmind-gemini-2-5-lineage.description: Two model cards for the Gemini 2.5 family: the Pro model card (Dec 2025) and the Deep Think model card (May 2026). Both inherit the framework's category structure and threshold language.

google-deepmind-blog-lineage.label: Google DeepMind blog posts (2025-2026)
google-deepmind-blog-lineage.description: Public blog posts that discuss the framework and the model cards. The blog is the public surface of the framework lineage.

fli-ai-safety-index-2026-summer.label: FLI AI Safety Index — Summer 2026 Edition
fli-ai-safety-index-2026-summer.description: Future of Life Institute's expert review of nine leading AI companies across 37 indicators in 6 domains. Seven expert graders score Google DeepMind at 2.01 / 4.0 (C). The evidence base for the Google DeepMind column is drawn from the same primary documents.
